_about: Forge services (Godot build: game/systems/forge.gd), at any npc with `forge: true` (a smith in any major town). `temper`: each rank counts as +1 item level, and the item's stats are worked out again by the item budget (docs/stats-and-damage.md). `caps` by rarity: how many ranks an item can take. `ranks` (one entry a rank, in order): bars and whetstones of the item's level band (`bars`, `whetstones`: the first band whose `upToLevel` is at least the item's level before the rank) and coins, plus `coinsPerItemLevel` x level coins on top. An epic or legendary item's last rank (its cap) also needs `lastRank`. `scrap` destroys an item for `baseBars` bars of its band (by rarity; cloth and leather give none), `refund` of every tempering material put in, and its gems back; the window shows what you get first. `reforge` swaps one of an item's stats for another, from `options` choices shown up front, for coins (one reforge an item; doing it again replaces it). `sockets`: a socket takes `share` of the item's stat budget, which a gem of its quality fills back (gems.json); a forge can punch one more (`punch`) into enhanced gear or better, to `max` sockets.
